name: Scarlet Watch Post
summary: In northeastern Tirisfal Glades, the rocky hills north of the Scarlet Monastery are under watch. The garrison guards the monastery’s northern flank against attack.

sections.title: Guarding the Northern Approach
sections.body:
Behind the Scarlet Monastery, Scarlet Watch Post watches the northern cliffs. The southern road to the gate is busy and fortified, but the rugged cliffs along Tirisfal’s northern coast offer infiltrators another way in. The Scarlet Crusade built the stone tower to guard that blind spot. It is one of several Crusader outposts scattered across Tirisfal Glades.

Captain Melrache commands a devout force of Neophytes, Vanguards, and Friars. They watch the cliffs so neither the Scourge nor the Forsaken can surprise the order from behind.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Scarlet Watch Post?
aliases: why is scarlet watch post here
faq.answer: Scarlet Watch Post guards the Scarlet Monastery against a northern flanking attack. Sentries watch the monastery’s rear slopes, which face the northern wilderness, and intercept intruders trying to bypass the monastery from that direction.

faq.q: Who commands the Scarlet Watch Post?
faq.answer: Captain Melrache commands the garrison at the tower. His force includes personal bodyguards, front-line Vanguards, aspiring Neophytes, and spellcasting Friars.

faq.q: Is the Scarlet Watch Post related to the other towers in Tirisfal?
faq.answer: Yes. Scarlet Watch Post is one of four Crusader outposts across the northern and western reaches of Tirisfal Glades. Together, the stone towers watch for Scourge activity and contain the Forsaken’s expansion from the Undercity.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you face the Scarlet Crusade near the Undercity. Attacking isolated towers like Scarlet Watch Post disrupts the zealots’ communications and helps secure northern Tirisfal.
As a member of the Horde, you’ll find Scarlet Watch Post hostile ground. The Crusaders see outsiders, living or dead, as tainted carriers of undeath.
